scripts.dev: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w packages/auth && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w packages/auth && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w packages/auth && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w apps/api && npm run test:unit -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/api-client && npm run build -w packages/auth && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
